g.text: Used for new Tainacan manual, scheduled and safety backups. Additional compression runs after WordPress
resumes. Existing backups keep their format. Restic controls compression inside its own repository.
What the platform backups encrypt: the configuration (passwords and keys of the platform) with this server's
key, which the recovery phrase opens. The files are encrypted only when they go to a restic repository, with
restic's own password (kept on this server and in the recovery kit). The database is not encrypted, in the
package nor in its cloud copy: keep the backup folder and the cloud account protected.
This server + restic repository /var/backups/koha-nexus/restic/tainacan + copy to
configuration encrypted with this server's key; files encrypted in the restic repository;
